title: Don't Sleep, Keep Watch: Proactive Perception for Computer-Use Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.28947v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Computer-use agents (CUAs) built on vision-language models are increasingly entrusted with long-horizon tasks in live desktop, web, and mobile environments, where the screen keeps changing on its own. However, current CUAs lack real-time situational awareness: they perceive the environment through discrete snapshots, and the substantial inference latency of VLMs, compounded by highly dynamic interfaces, opens a perception-action gap in which the observed state frequently becomes stale before the corresponding action is executed. To bridge this gap, we present NightWatch, a plug-and-play framework that endows any CUA with continuous, temporally grounded perception without changing the agent's model, prompt, or action space. translated_title: 不要沉睡，持续守望：面向计算机使用代理的主动感知
translated_abstract: 基于视觉-语言模型构建的计算机使用代理（CUA）越来越多地被委托在实时桌面、网页和移动环境中执行长时程任务，而这些环境中屏幕会自行持续变化。然而，当前的CUA缺乏实时态势感知能力：它们通过离散的快照来感知环境，VLM巨大的推理延迟加上高度动态的界面，造成了感知与行动之间的鸿沟——观察到的状态在相应动作执行之前经常已经过时。为了弥合这一鸿沟，我们提出了NightWatch，一个即插即用的框架，能够在不改变代理的模型、提示或动作空间的情况下，赋予任何CUA持续的、具备时间定位能力的感知。NightWatch将VLM代理与NightWatch-0.8B（一个轻量级的System-1模型）相耦合，该模型对界面状态进行流式监控，并以较低的计算开销使代理与不断演进的环境保持同步。
tldr: 提出NightWatch，一个即插即用框架，通过耦合轻量级System-1模型NightWatch-0.8B对界面状态进行流式监控，为计算机使用代理提供持续的实时感知，从而弥合因VLM推理延迟导致的感知与行动之间的时间鸿沟。
en_tdlr: We present NightWatch, a plug-and-play framework that couples any computer-use agent with NightWatch-0.8B, a lightweight System-1 model performing streaming interface monitoring, enabling continuous temporally-grounded perception to bridge the perception-action gap caused by VLM inference latency.
